$comment: The two mottoes and eight values, as data, for the AI system prompt and any future app surface. Wording is authoritative and matches docs/constitution/03 and 04 exactly. Do not reword casually — these are the family's own sentences.

mottoes.meaning: We strive to treat every person as the Savior would — with charity, kindness, patience, forgiveness, honesty, and courage.
mottoes.childPrompt: What would loving like Jesus look like right now?

mottoes.meaning: We strive to make decisions with eternity in mind, choosing what will bring us closer to Jesus Christ, strengthen our family, and bless others.
mottoes.childPrompt: What choice would I make if I were thinking celestial?

values.text: We love and serve each other.
We work hard and do hard things.
We tell the truth and keep our promises.
We choose kindness over being right.
We keep learning, growing, and repenting.
We leave every person and place better than we found it.

mantras.text: The person comes before the problem.
Find joy in the journey — now.
Joy is about where we look.
Some blessings come late. They still come.
Learn from it. Don't live in it.

$mantraNote: Text only. The verified quotations behind each mantra live in src/config/mantras.ts and docs/constitution/05, and the AI must cite from there rather than reconstructing a quote from the mantra text.
